cues: If objects can be reused, the choices never shrink: r places, n choices each, n to the power r. Post five letters into three boxes.
Do not let the boxes choose; a box can take many letters.
Let each letter choose its box: three choices, five times over.
Three to the five, two hundred and forty three.
text: If objects can be reused, the choices never shrink: r places, n choices each, n to the power r. Post five letters into three boxes. Do not let the boxes choose; a box can take many letters. Let each letter choose its box: three choices, five times over. Three to the five, two hundred and forty three. Not five cubed.
